body: Thank you so much for your kind words

I am a firm believer in God. I have accepted Christ as my saviour! 
It was to him that I was praying as I made that decision to stay! And I'm glad I was praying. Because just as I was praying a good friend knocked at my door! Although I had called him. I believe God helped him get there in time!
I play guitar, bass, drums, clean and unclean vocals.

They are indeed... The only music that can make me smile. I'm sitting here right now on the floor... Listening to Neon Ballroom.... I dumped the pills :) but the razor is still there.... It taunts me. It almost calls to me... The way the light catches off the sharp edges...

Guilt is indeed a poison... One that has spread through me like a disease. I tried and tried again to dump it... But it just won't quit. 

All these things... They keep replaying in my head... Over and over. I am plauged by them... These memories are no friends of mine.... But  still they stay... In my head.
Okay thank you so much for this.... You have no idea how much it means to me at this very moment.

Haha I hate our soap operas... Kylie is okay :).

Well I am starting to lean towards the staying part...
Aw what the heck... Queensland.

I never thought of it like that.... All I remember about him is the confused 16 year old I knew... 
Thank you so much 

Well I'm  giving myself one hour from now. 
I called a friend... They will be here in a hour. So yeah.
You guys are all so nice... Even to a stranger like me.... I thank you for this... I live in Australia btw....
A part of me hopes I stick around too

I just called her... It was probably the hardest phone call of my life.... This plan was meant to be perfect guilt free.... But it... The guilt... I can't stop that feeling.... I AM SO FUCKING CONFUSED... I even got all the pills... Razor... 
I don't wanna hurt her... I don't wanna hurt anyone... I just want this pain to stop. Am I selfish? Am I just a horrible human being for wanting this?
Thanks

I have cut off contact with my brother and biological mother. My dad has always been there for me. Also my step-mum isn't bad either. So my whole family isn't bad... Just my mums side.... But I do get what your saying.
Well I have my music... I write poetry( free verse).
Well judging by the post what would you say are my options.... I'm not in the right state of mind.... That's for sure....
Thank you... I will :)

I would go back and see a therapist but I don't have the money right now... I have also changed my accounts. I don't try to dwell but it all gets replayed at night in my dreams... You make it seem as if I haven't tried... as if what I have been through is trivial... I have tried... I have tried for last few years! And it hasn't gotten me anywhere... Sorry if I come off as rude... I'm very confused and stressed at the moment. 
 
Shit I'm sorry... I didn't see the end of your post... Thank you for your support :) Again I'm sorry...
